name: @repo/ai-loader
description: Family of AI waiting indicators — dots, sweep bar and pixel grid — sharing one cycle length, with an optional elapsed counter.

useCases: Waiting indicator while a model is working
Inline indicator inside a message list
Long-running agent step with an elapsed counter
compositionHints: All variants share one cycle, so mixing them stays in sync
Never fakes determinate progress for an unknown wait
Use showElapsed for waits that can run past a couple of seconds
